parts.label: (a)
(a)(i)
parts.text: Use VSEPR theory to predict the shape of a molecule of $\text{SCl}_2$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Predict the bond angle in a molecule of $\text{SCl}_2$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: $\text{SCl}_2$ is a red liquid that reacts with water. $$2\text{SCl}_2\text{(l)} + 3\text{H}_2\text{O(l)} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SO}_3\text{(aq)} + \text{S(s)} + 4\text{HCl(aq)}$$

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Describe two observations, other than temperature change, that are made when an excess of water is added to $\text{SCl}_2$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
When $\text{SCl}_2$ reacts with water, the $\text{SCl}_2$ is broken down and a disproportionation reaction occurs.

State the oxidation numbers of sulfur in $\text{SCl}_2$ and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_3$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State the general name to describe the type of reaction that occurs when a substance is broken down by water.
